title: Epilepsy: first aid during a seizure and daily life
also: what to do during a seizure
what: Epilepsy is a condition with repeated seizures. Medicines help most people. It is important for family and friends to know how to help during a seizure.
why: For people with epilepsy, their family, teachers, and coworkers.
duration: a seizure usually lasts 1 to 3 minutes
tell_doctor: How often seizures happen and what they look like
If seizures became more frequent or changed
All other medicines, since some affect anti-seizure drugs
If you are pregnant or planning a pregnancy

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Take them every day at the same time. Do not stop or change the dose on your own.

prepare.title: Diary
prepare.text: Write down seizures: the date, the time, and how long they lasted.

prepare.title: Triggers
prepare.text: Lack of sleep, alcohol, and missed pills often bring on a seizure.

bring: A video of a seizure, if relatives managed to film one
steps: During a seizure, stay calm and note the time
Move hard and sharp objects away
Put something soft under the head
Do not hold the person down or put anything in their mouth
When the jerking stops, turn the person onto their side
Stay with them until they are fully back to normal
feel: After a seizure the person is often sleepy and confused, which is normal
A headache and sore muscles are possible
after: Write the seizure in the diary
Do not swim alone or bathe in a tub unsupervised
Whether you may drive is your doctor's decision
red_flags: A seizure lasting more than 5 minutes: call emergency services
One seizure after another and the person does not come round: call emergency services
A seizure in water, with an injury, in pregnancy, or the first one: call emergency services
Trouble breathing after a seizure: call emergency services

faq.q: Is it true you should hold the tongue?
faq.a: No. Put nothing in the mouth, since you can break teeth and cause injury.

faq.q: Can I work and study with epilepsy?
faq.a: Yes, most people live a normal life. Your doctor will tell you about any limits.

reminders.text: Time for your seizure medicine. Do not skip it.
